name: Nablus

queries.query: Nablus Palestine cadastral parcel map official land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party/official results identified the Palestinian Land Authority, its Nablus locality/settlement page, and the official Geomolg ParcelSearch viewer. The viewer documents a registered-parcels layer sourced from PLA, but direct service metadata required a token.

queries.query: فلسطين نابلس خريطة قطع الأراضي السجل العقاري رسمي
queries.result: Official Arabic results evidenced the Nablus land-registration office, the Nablus settlement office, and official PLA procedures. The Geomolg viewer configuration identifies the PLA registered-parcels layer, but no anonymous parcel response was available.

registryEvidence.custodian: Palestinian Land Authority; Nablus land-registration and land-settlement offices
registryEvidence.scopeNote: Official PLA pages identify Nablus registration/settlement offices and Nablus settlement progress. This evidences a local registry custodian, not open citywide parcel geometry access.

parcelDiscovery.note: Viewer configuration exposed layer schema and extent, but no polygon response was retained. The exact WUP point was not shifted and was not used as an absence test.

uncertainty: GET requests to the official ArcGIS service root and parcel layer returned HTTP 499 Token Required; no token was used or retained.
GET https://geo.pla.pna.ps/ failed TLS certificate verification; no certificate exception was authorized or used, and the HTTP fallback timed out.
The viewer page is a public Geomolg configuration, but its parcel service is token-gated at the direct REST endpoint; this is not evidence of citywide absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
